title: FactorEngine: A Program-level Knowledge-Infused Factor Mining Framework for Quantitative Investment
selection_reason: The current v2 paper's end-to-end example explicitly contrasts a seed with the representative factor produced after 40 FactorEngine evolution iterations. The evolved program is the strongest concrete source-produced factor and was selected before its monthly JKP return was computed.

source_program.mechanism: Three turnover-weighted intrabar price-pressure components are cross-sectionally rank normalized, combined 0.25/0.25/0.50, exponentially smoothed by security, and cross-sectionally z-scored.
source_program.direction: positive source output; no sign is selected on JKP
source_program.compatibility_repair: Restore daily_range_expr = high - low immediately before its first use, matching the executable seed listing directly above and every denominator described by the evolved program.

jkp_mapping.open: abs(prc)/(1+ret) when ret>-1; prior-close-implied monthly open proxy
jkp_mapping.turnover: tvol*abs(prc), preserving the literal volume*close source expression
jkp_mapping.cadence: one source observation and the five-period EWM become one month and five months
jkp_mapping.universe: largest 1,000 eligible U.S. stocks by formation-date market equity

common_task_adaptations.portfolio: common value-weighted long/short deciles because the showcased program emits only a score

full_system_not_reproduced: The program-level LLM evolution, research-report ingestion, prompts/responses, and 40-iteration trajectory.
The unreleased generated factor pool and LightGBM synthesis behind headline tables.
The original Qlib A-share data, point-in-time constituents, predictions, holdings, and returns.
The author runtime and environment; the listing is translated directly into pandas arithmetic.
A pristine confirmatory test; prior project and JKP outcomes were already visible.
outcome_selection_guard: Do not change the one-line repair, default weights, smoothing, direction, field mapping, portfolio, or costs after observing JKP performance. A negative or benchmark-explained result closes the milestone.
